name: skeptic-fatal-verdict-contradicts-numerics-readjudicate
description: Skeptic FATAL contradicting numerics must be re-adjudicated, not obeyed. When a falsification probe or adversarial reviewer returns a route-killing verdict that conflicts with the project's own simulation data (or a prior independent refutation), re-dispatch the SAME skeptic with the contradicting facts inlined and ask it to confirm-or-recant, rather than accepting the kill. Trigger phrases: skeptic FATAL contradicts numerics, probe says beta=1 but numerics say more, re-adjudicate before killing route, falsification verdict vs measured data, confirm-or-recant skeptic, route nearly killed by category error, numerics override skeptic, FATAL verdict conflicts simulation, wrong-process verdict re-check, do not act on REJECT that contradicts data.

name: paper-dev-review-layers-are-mandatory
description: Mandatory paper development review layers. Enforce independent review cadence across authoring and preparation cycles without resetting debt on quota stops or renamed drafts. Trigger phrases: review debt, three rounds without review, quota stopped reviewer, candidate-only round, pre-proof gate, mandatory skeptic, combined output limit, supplement equivalence, numeric reviewer confidence, statement ordinal, source content identity.

name: new-open-problem-numerics-repo
description: Scaffold a private GitHub repo for numerically exploring a mathematical open problem (NOT a paper-writing repo). Differs from new-article-project in that the deliverable is numerical evidence / a published note about an open question, not a finished LaTeX manuscript. Includes Python numerics scaffold (codes/numerics, codes/analysis), data/figs directories, PHASE-style findings documents, AGENTS.md tuned for hand-off between AI sessions, and a HANDOFF.md brief. Trigger when user says "create a repo for this open problem", "set up exploration for X conjecture", "private repo to numerically test Y", or "start a numerics project on Z" — especially when the open problem has a clear conjecture (e.g., universality, q-independence, rate function form) that can be tested via Monte Carlo or related numerics.
